description: Pin the fast-xml-parser dependency in the RSS package to a specific working version to prevent installation failures caused by a broken upstream release. This ensures users can reliably install and use the RSS functionality without encountering dependency-related errors.
functional_requirements: Update the fast-xml-parser dependency in the RSS package's package.json to pin to a specific version known to work correctly
Ensure the dependency lock file reflects this pinned version to guarantee consistent installations across all environments
Document the version pinning in the appropriate changelog or changeset file to track this dependency management change
